title: Backfill duration at two throttles
method: Synthetic 12-million-row backfill with 500 rows per batch. Duration = rows/(batch size × batches per minute). Excludes pauses, validation, retries and replica catch-up; use measured rehearsal distributions for scheduling.
alt: Backfill duration at two throttles. 250 batches/minute: 96 minutes; 125 batches/minute: 192 minutes. Illustrative values.
